title: Known limitation: kNN sanitisation is blind to boundary-targeted label flipping

invariants.description: Flipping the 35 class-1 samples nearest the clean boundary must still break ≥ 15% of correctly classified class-1 test samples.
After kNN sanitisation the boundary-targeted attack must still succeed on ≥ 15%. If this drops, check whether the attack regressed BEFORE concluding the defense improved.
Boundary flips sit where neighbours already carry the flipped label, so kNN flags almost none of them.

Sanitisation must NOT significantly reduce the boundary-targeted attack (observed 17 → 16 broken, McNemar p = 0.5). If this becomes significant, check whether the attack regressed before concluding the defense improved.

rationale: Pins the gap between MLB-REG-006 and an informed attacker (knowledge of clean-model margins), so the lab cannot silently start overstating this defense.
